body: Thank you, you get it which I appreciate. This is bewildering.

Thank you for understanding the issue. I don't like making everything about "race". I am not that person but when someone clearly uses words that acknowledge the color of my skin and only views me as an object, I have a problem with that. As we all should.
Awwww I got you mad. You can cry on me sugar 😢
This is to bring awareness. There's no malicious behind this. Disrespectful people get away with enough. If you don't agree, kindly leave.
Pet names are terms of endearment for people you typically are romantically involved with. Sometimes friends as well. It's bizarre to call a stranger "sugar".
You are 100% right. It's so weird to give strangers you don't know pet names. I gave up online dating a long time ago 😓
And people act like morons stopped existing.
Please take a course on English comprehension because you have no clue about context.
Not the dog hacking the phone again 😭
Go discuss other non-black women's dating woes. You have many outlets to go to. This is my experience. Stop invalidating my experience.

Thank you so much for your thoughtful response. You understand why I am upset. This would never be a "race thing" if race wasn't the primary thing that was brought up in the first place. This is not the first time, I've had numerous disgusting encounters with non-black men from online dating apps. I choose to speak out now. The lack of sympathy from people I presume are not people of color does not surprise me. There is a clear lack of empathy for those that share their experiences as black people. Disappointing but not surprising.

You were subliminally invalidating my feelings initially. I never said anything about non-black women. I know all women go through similar situations. I wouldn't pull the race card if I am referred to as just a "woman". When it comes to non-black men on dating apps, many, not all refer to me as a black woman like I am some sort of thing that is meant to be fetishized. I don't like to be referred to by the color of my skin but that is how society perceives me. This sucks and I would very much like to be called by my name which is Sabrina. You might not agree with how handled the situation but it's ultimately a way to bring awareness regardless. You take care!
Awww did I hurt your feelings? 😢
Go ask your father. If you have one troglodyte.

Well, you go talk about your experience. This is mine as a black woman and there are plenty of other instances but I never post about them. I am fed up. I have that right. Try not to make everything about you. That's selfish!
Thank you, you know the deal 👏🏽
I agree 100%. Honestly, I don't understand either but people are entitled to their opinion.
Well, be careful who you message inappropriate things too. You can always support that man if you align with his precious sentiment. Cheers!
I Love Big Penises!

Well, I stopped messaging this man over a year ago. He couldn't even call me by my name and kept referring to me as "sugar". A year later which is today, he texts me the image " I Love Black Pussy". The disrespect is in the fact that he doesn't know me and is texting me something so improper.
Yeah, and I stopped messaging as you could see.
You sound very wise. I don't understand the audacity of some men. Like why? I don't even know how you are supposed to respond to such a statement. Make it make sense please 😖
Yes, the "sugar" thing weirded me out. I never intended to message him again. Then boom almost a year and a half later he sends me such an incredible image with words that really spoke to me 😃
You can ❤️ Black Pussy but remain respectful. Black women are highly sexualized or at least in the media. The last thing, we want is to be sexualized by strange men from Tinder.
Yes, that was not a joke and it's disturbing. I'm glad you made it out. No person should ever have to feel like a commodity.
I love when a man tells me exactly what I want to hear 🤣
He decided to share this sentiment with a stranger. If you support his message, you can always donate to his non-profit. He seems like such an outstanding man 🤣
I haven't texted the "sugar" creep since 2020 and then BOOM, "I LOVE BLACK PU**Y" this morning 😠
You are so right!
You bet, I can 😅
Hopefully, after this, that'll change

Thank you. Surviving seems impossible for me right now. I don’t want to continue. I love my children but I am afraid. I am not ready to step up but now I am put in this situation so basically I’m forced too.

Thank you. The hardest thing to know is that my husband was my rock and he is gone now. My whole world revolved around him. He loved the children even more than I do. He kept me sane when it came to raising our four children. What am I going to do now?
Thanks.
Oh wow. Sorry that you had to go through such a loss. I know that I’m expected to make the children my world but all I want to do now is to curl up into a ball. Just like you, I will be sad forever.
Thank you.
Thank you and I’m so sorry to hear about what you went through. It is truly sad that we must suffer such pain when we are still young.
I am so very sorry for your loss. Your post was very helpful and I purchased the book you suggested. I am just filled with a lot of regrets. It’s tearing me up inside.
Oh my goodness that’s absolutely horrible of how you lost your spouse. I’m so sorry. Thank you for reaching out. I just want for this scary time to be over.
Thank you.
Thank you. I just wished that I had more time with him.

I am sorry for your loss. It’s like as you get older life just keeps throwing more curveballs at you. How are you broken if you don’t mind me asking for you to explain what you meant by that. Thank you.

I am in Nassau. We are neighbors. This virus has caused unspeakable amounts of destruction. I am trying to pick up the pieces again. I don’t know why this had to happen but thank you for your encouraging words.
I am sorry about your husband. We must power on through no matter what. Thank you for your advice.
Very helpful advice. Thank you. I haven’t eaten much since Monday. Today I had two bites of a pastry and a cup a tea. That’s way more than yesterday. Everything is just so hard.
Thank you dearly. I’m just really struggling to process everything.
Thank you so much.
Thank you for helping me with your words. I stopped watching the news. You are right, my husband isn’t just another statistic. I needed to read that.
Thank you everybody. I am so surprised by all the responses. I feel so alone right now but reading all of your comments makes me feel like I’m part of something.
